item.title: Self-Hosted Kubernetes Advanced Workload Controllers: OpenKruise vs Argo Rollouts vs Flagger
item.description: When managing large-scale Kubernetes deployments, the native Deployment and StatefulSet controllers often fall short. Features like in-place updates, batch pod deletion, calculated pod destruction ordering, and advanced canary releases require extending Kubernetes with custom workload controllers. This guide compares three leading approaches: OpenKruise, Argo Rollouts, and Flagger — each solving different aspects of advanced workload management on self-hosted Kubernetes clusters.
